description: Small branch-local Ralph cycle focused on verifiable Pipeline service/operator gaps after PR CI was confirmed green.

userStories.title: Record Scheduled Pipeline Ticks as Run History
userStories.description: As a pipeline operator, I want cron-triggered pipeline ticks to create durable run-history rows even before the full runtime executor is wired, so the product surface shows that schedules are firing instead of leaving only server logs.

acceptanceCriteria.given: an enabled scheduled pipeline and the server scheduler runner receives a cron tick
acceptanceCriteria.when: the runtime executor is not configured
acceptanceCriteria.then: the pipeline store receives a terminal run row for that pipeline with triggeredBy=schedule

acceptanceCriteria.given: the scheduler records a runtime-not-configured tick
acceptanceCriteria.when: the run row is inspected through the existing run-history store contract
acceptanceCriteria.then: it includes startedAt, finishedAt, failed status, and an explanatory errorMessage
the error is propagated to the scheduler logger instead of being swallowed silently

userStories.title: Surface Pipeline Run History in the Pipeline Log Panel
userStories.description: As a pipeline operator, I want the Web Pipeline log panel to read the existing runs endpoint so I can see recent scheduled ticks and failures without leaving the UI.

acceptanceCriteria.given: a selected pipeline has recent runs
acceptanceCriteria.when: the Pipelines page renders its log panel
acceptanceCriteria.then: the panel lists recent run status, trigger, timestamp, and error text

acceptanceCriteria.given: a selected pipeline has no runs
acceptanceCriteria.then: the log panel shows an empty run-history state instead of saying run history is not implemented

userStories.title: Persist Real Scheduled Pipeline DAG Outcomes
userStories.description: As a pipeline operator, I want scheduled pipelines with an available runtime runner to persist actual DAG success/failure results, so run history evolves from tick evidence into execution evidence.

acceptanceCriteria.given: a scheduled pipeline and a configured DAG node runner
acceptanceCriteria.then: the stored pipeline run includes the RunDAG result and success status

acceptanceCriteria.given: a scheduled pipeline whose DAG execution fails
acceptanceCriteria.then: the stored run includes failed status, the RunDAG partial result, and the error message
